sections.text:
يتكون نظام الاطفاء الذاتى بغاز 
 Co2 من عدد من الاسطوانات يوجد بداخلها غاز ثانى اكسيد 
 الكربون فى حالته السائلة تحت ضغط 80 بار تقريبا كما يتم وضع هذه الاسطوانات فى 
 مجموعات طبقا لكمية الغاز المطلوبة للاطفاء وتكون كل مجموعة من هذه المجموعات 
 مخصصة لاطفاء الحريق فى منطقة محددة تتناسب مع حجم الغاز داخل هذه الاسطوانات 
 ويوجد رشاشات لغاز الاطفاء ومكثفات لهب موزعة كما بالجدول التالى:-

وكل من مكتشف اللهب 
والحرارة لها خطين غير معتمدين على بعضهما ولكى يعمل نظام الحريق لا بد ان تاتى 
اشارة انذار بوجود حريق من احد مكتشفات الحريق على الخط الاول 
مقترنة بانذار على 
احد مكتشفات الحريق على الخط الثانى فان سولونيد تحرير الاوزان يتحرق فيعمل نظام 
الحريق وفى نفس الوقت تذهب اشارة الخروج الاضطرارى 
Trip من مفتاح
limit switch الى مختلف مكونات الوحدة لكى تتوقف

ويعتبر جهاز وزن 
الاسطوانة هو المؤشر لحدوث تسرب مادة الاطفاء من اسطوانة ثانى اكسيد الكربون ويتم 
ضبط جهاز مبين التهريب بحيث يعطى اشارة بوجود التهريب عندما يحدث فقد فى محتوى 
الاسطوانة من مادة الاطفاء بحد اقصى 10% من الوزن الاجمالى للاسطوانة حيث يسقط 
الثقل الاسطوانى رقم 1 الى السفل عند حدوث ذلك ويكون هذا هو المؤشر لانخفاض وزن 
الاسطوانة نتيجة حدوث تسريب للغاز بها فيتم تغييرها

تم اعداد 
هذا المستند بواسطة السيد المهندس / يسرى عبد الحليم عبد اللطيف واختبره السيد المهندس / وصفى 
وليم ناشد - كبير مهندسين ادارة السلامة والصحة المهنية 
ووافق عليه السيد المهندس / محمد محمد اللاوندى المدير العام وتمت المراجعة من السيد الكيميائى / احمد السيد ابراهيم 
والسيد المهندس / سليمان زكى سليمان مدير عام ضمان وتأكيد الجودة وتم اعتماده من السيد المهندس / محمد محمد فرج عنان - رئيس قطاع محطة 
توليد كهرباء دمياط 
والسيد 
المهندس/ 
محمد حسين جمعه رئيس قطاع

rows: Equipment: Automatic CO2 gas fire extinguishing system for the Siemens V94.2 VZ2 gas unit, Preussag – Minimax
Issued to: Damietta Combined Cycle Power Station
Procedure: Adjusting the cylinder weighing device (leak indicator device)

sections_en.text: The automatic CO2 gas fire extinguishing system consists of a number of cylinders containing carbon dioxide gas in its liquid state under a pressure of approximately 80 bar. The cylinders are arranged in groups according to the quantity of gas required for extinguishing, and each group is dedicated to extinguishing a fire in a specific area matching the volume of gas inside these cylinders. There are extinguishing gas nozzles and flame detectors distributed as shown in the following table:

Each of the flame and heat detectors has two independent lines, and for the fire system to operate a fire alarm signal must come from one of the fire detectors on the first line together with an alarm from one of the fire detectors on the second line. The weight-release solenoid then moves, the fire system operates, and at the same time the emergency trip signal goes from the limit switch to the various components of the unit so that they stop.

The cylinder weighing device is the indicator of leakage of the extinguishing agent from the carbon dioxide cylinder. The leak indicator device is adjusted so that it gives a leakage signal when the cylinder loses extinguishing agent up to a maximum of 10% of the total weight of the cylinder, at which point cylindrical weight No. 1 drops down; this is the indication that the cylinder weight has fallen as a result of gas leakage, and the cylinder is then replaced.

Soliman Zaki Soliman, General Manager of Quality Assurance and Quality Control, and approved by Eng. Mohamed Mohamed Farag Anan – Head of Damietta Power Station Sector – and Eng. Mohamed Hussein Gomaa, Head of Quality Assurance and Quality Control Sector, East Delta Electricity Production Company.

Release the cylindrical weight to undo the locking nuts No. 3
Turn the cylindrical weight No. 1 anticlockwise on the threaded shaft No. 2 until the cylindrical weight is just horizontally balanced
Turn the cylindrical weight clockwise by three turns
Tighten the locking nuts No. 3 and secure the position of the cylindrical weight with locking wire No. 4

Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Maintenance Procedures Information System
 | Fire Protection Systems | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: FS-045-R0A | Equipment: Automatic CO2 gas fire extinguishing system for the Siemens V94.2 VZ2 gas unit, Preussag – Minimax
Issued to: Damietta Combined Cycle Power Station
Document status: Approved
Date of document approval: 2 July 2008 | Procedure: Adjusting the cylinder weighing device (leak indicator device)
Date of next review: July 2013
Introduction
The automatic CO2 gas fire extinguishing system consists of a number of cylinders containing carbon dioxide gas in its liquid state under a pressure of approximately 80 bar. The cylinders are arranged in groups according to the quantity of gas required for extinguishing, and each group is dedicated to extinguishing a fire in a specific area matching the volume of gas inside these cylinders. There are extinguishing gas nozzles and flame detectors distributed as shown in the following table:
Flame detector | Heat detector | Nozzles | Number of cylinders | 
1 | 4 | 4 | 3 | Right combustion chamber
1 | 4 | 4 | 3 | Left combustion chamber
1 | 4 | 8 | 7 | Oil tank
Each of the flame and heat detectors has two independent lines, and for the fire system to operate a fire alarm signal must come from one of the fire detectors on the first line together with an alarm from one of the fire detectors on the second line. The weight-release solenoid then moves, the fire system operates, and at the same time the emergency trip signal goes from the limit switch to the various components of the unit so that they stop.
The cylinder weighing device is the indicator of leakage of the extinguishing agent from the carbon dioxide cylinder. The leak indicator device is adjusted so that it gives a leakage signal when the cylinder loses extinguishing agent up to a maximum of 10% of the total weight of the cylinder, at which point cylindrical weight No. 1 drops down; this is the indication that the cylinder weight has fallen as a result of gas leakage, and the cylinder is then replaced.
This document was prepared by Eng. Yousry Abdel Halim Abdel Latif, tested by Eng. Wasfy William Nashed – Senior Engineer, Occupational Safety and Health Department – and approved by Eng. Mohamed Mohamed El-Lawandy, General Manager. It was reviewed by Chemist Ahmed El-Sayed Ibrahim and Eng. Soliman Zaki Soliman, General Manager of Quality Assurance and Quality Control, and approved by Eng. Mohamed Mohamed Farag Anan – Head of Damietta Power Station Sector – and Eng. Mohamed Hussein Gomaa, Head of Quality Assurance and Quality Control Sector, East Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Open a work order by the Occupational Safety and Health Department | 
Wear personal protective equipment | 
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Cylinder hoist | 
Spanner No. 29 – adjustable spanner – pliers | 
Procedure to be Carried Out
Release the cylindrical weight to undo the locking nuts No. 3 | 1.
Turn the cylindrical weight No. 1 anticlockwise on the threaded shaft No. 2 until the cylindrical weight is just horizontally balanced | 2.
Turn the cylindrical weight clockwise by three turns | 3
Tighten the locking nuts No. 3 and secure the position of the cylindrical weight with locking wire No. 4 | 4
